I will not put chemical fertilizer on this beans plot because legumes make their own nitrogen, and anyway my fertilizer coupon must go to the maize field. I will spread manure from our cattle before planting because it is free and makes the soil good for beans, and I will use seed I kept from last season. We will weed by hand when the rains come and I do not need to hire anyone because my children and I can manage this plot together.
